A quadrupedal '''creature''' with a long-snout and thick, armor-like plates on its body was captured by [[Dulok/Legends|Duloks]] and [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and kept in a cage in a forest covered with snow, until the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] known as [[Asha/Legends|Asha]] broke open the cage door. It quickly fled the cage as the Duloks captured Asha with their lassos.<ref name="A" />

{{Creature-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The creature appeared in the ''[[Ewoks (television series)|Ewoks]]'' episode "[[Asha (episode)|Asha]]." It strongly resembled a real-life armadillo.<ref name="A" />
